1058-progress.name: Witch Doctor Jin'Zil
1058-progress.text:
Look at our poor little elf friends. All caged up with no forest to frolic in!

Now were you able to find me some sap? How about the whiskers from the twilight runners? Don't suppose you have that fey dragon scale on you?

And eyes! I'll need so many eyes! You just can't mix up a fierce forest magic brew without a good helping of eyes!
1058-progress.title: Jin'Zil's Forest Magic

1060-progress.name: Witch Doctor Jin'Zil
1060-progress.text: You seem a shady character. You have something for me to see?
1060-progress.title: Letter to Jin'Zil

1195-progress.name: Zangen Stonehoof
1195-progress.text: Once we have the filled phial, we can send it along to my associate, Rau, in the Thousand Needles. He was the one who requested the phial of water, so he'll better know how we can make use of it.
1195-progress.title: The Sacred Flame

1480-progress.name: Maurin Bonesplitter
1480-progress.text:
The Burning Blade begin to realize how weak they truly are. Their magics are pathetic, their strength feeble.

Their only power comes from those they serve, and not from any understanding of true power and knowledge.
1480-progress.title: The Corrupter

1656-progress.name: Innkeeper Kauth
1656-progress.text:
Yes, young one? What can Kauth do for you?

The journey here from the Mesa can be a tremendous burden for some, but a welcome sight for others. Which is it for you, I wonder?
1656-progress.title: A Task Unfinished

2-progress.name: Senani Thunderheart
2-progress.text: Yes, mighty $c, I sensed your arrival.  I trust you have more news to report to me about your hunt?
2-progress.title: Sharptalon's Claw

24-progress.name: Senani Thunderheart
24-progress.text: Greetings once again, $N!  Have you come to show me proof of your hunt?
24-progress.title: Shadumbra's Head

3376-progress.name: Brave Windfeather
3376-progress.text:
Sharptusk will trouble us no more once you have brought me proof of his death.  It is his head that I seek, $N.

We tauren live for the hunt, and there is no greater hunt than against one that is cunning enough to perhaps hunt us back.  If you are successful in this task, young one, you will start to learn what I mean.
3376-progress.title: Break Sharptusk!

5561-progress.name: Smeed Scrabblescrew
5561-progress.text: The caravan will be here shortly; do you have the five new tamed kodos I was asking for?
5561-progress.title: Kodo Roundup

6283-progress.name: Maggran Earthbinder
6283-progress.text:
Bloodfury Ripper is a nasty creature! You will have success finding her along the western hill line in the Charred Vale.

The bloodfuries will be helpless with out... surely we can vanquish them forever!
6283-progress.title: Bloodfury Bloodline

6301-progress.name: Tammra Windfield
6301-progress.text: The continuous destruction caused by war and those that seek a profit from lumber pains me deeply. To aid the cycle of rebirth and replenish the lands, I need Gaea seeds. Do you have them, $c?
6301-progress.title: Cycle of Rebirth

6381-progress.name: Tammra Windfield
6381-progress.text:
These seeds you plant are strong, resisting corruption, and making a foothold for other life. They will grow and grow, first preventing corruption and healing the scarred land, and then one day, restoring Stonetalon to a lush forest, once again.

Have you planted all of the Gaea seeds?
6381-progress.title: New Life

6393-progress.name: Tsunaman
6393-progress.text: The Tribunal of the Tides grows impatient. They seek to end this war that has raged across all dimensions for eons. My brethren are anxious to hear news of the glorious victory over the hated fire elementals. Have you the Incendrites that I require?
6393-progress.title: Elemental War

6421-progress.name: Mor'rogal
6421-progress.text: What news have you discovered from Boulderslide Ravine? I recall some legend that deals with Resonite... I just cannot place my hoof on it. Perhaps knowing what lies at the bottom of the cave will illuminate their devious intentions.
6421-progress.title: Boulderslide Ravine

6462-complete.name: Mitsuwa
6462-complete.text:
You found them!  Thank you!  Thank you, $N!  You do not know how great a thing you have done for me.

A troll without his charm is like an $r without his battle scars...

Worthless.
6462-complete.title: Troll Charm

6462-progress.name: Mitsuwa
6462-progress.text: Did you find the charms, $N?  Every moment the furbolgs possess those sacred items, my blood boils with rage!
6462-progress.title: Troll Charm

6571-progress.name: Locke Okarr
6571-progress.text: I hope you can come through with the supplies! I'm in big trouble if I don't deliver them soon!
6571-progress.title: Warsong Supplies

6621-progress.name: Karang Amakkar
6621-progress.text: Did you defeat Chief Murgut, $N?  Did you retrieve his Foulweald Totem?
6621-progress.title: King of the Foulweald

747-progress.name: Grull Hawkwind
747-progress.text: Providing meat and feathers for the tribe is the first step in proving yourself as a $c before the Chief.
747-progress.title: The Hunt Begins

750-progress.name: Grull Hawkwind
750-progress.text: If you can provide pelts for the tribe I will pass word along to my father, Chief Hawkwind, of your generous deeds.
750-progress.title: The Hunt Continues

753-progress.name: Chief Hawkwind
753-progress.text: You look as though you have returned from the plains. Do you have any word from Greatmother Hawkwind?
753-progress.title: A Humble Task

757-progress.name: Chief Hawkwind
757-progress.text: Have you completed the Rite of Strength, $N? I require proof of your valor against the enemy of our tribe, the Bristlebacks.
757-progress.title: Rite of Strength

761-accept.name: Harken Windtotem
761-accept.text:
The swoop is a cunning bird, and difficult to find and hunt.  A collection of Swoop Quills is a badge of cleverness and determination for a $c.

If you are willing to take up this task, then enter the plains and hunt the swoop.

Bring me their quills, and bring honor to your clan.

The swoops may be found anywhere in Mulgore, but your eyes must be sharp to spot them, and your hooves must be quick to catch them.
761-accept.title: Swoop Hunting

763-progress.name: Baine Bloodhoof
763-progress.text: What brings you to my village, $c?
763-progress.title: Rites of the Earthmother

765-progress.name: Morin Cloudstalker
765-progress.text: I seethe with anger at the thought of the atrocities the Venture Co. is willing to perpetrate against us in the name of profit.
765-progress.title: Supervisor Fizsprocket

770-complete.name: Skorn Whitecloud
770-complete.text:
I can barely believe my old eyes!  You defeated the great wolf Ghost Howl?  I look upon you with new respect, young $c.  You are a $c of extreme skills!

Let me offer you something.  My days of hunting are over, but I would be honored if you used one of my weapons in your hunts.

May it strike true, and bring you renown.

And let us hope that Ghost Howl's spirit has finally found peace.
770-complete.title: The Demon Scarred Cloak

776-progress.name: Cairne Bloodhoof
776-progress.text: Have you tracked down Arra'chea yet?
776-progress.title: Rites of the Earthmother

780-progress.name: Grull Hawkwind
780-progress.text: The aggression of the Battleboars is increasing. Have you sent them a clear message and brought back some snouts and flanks yet?
780-progress.title: The Battleboars

78124-complete.name: Owen Thadd
78124-complete.text:
Thank you, $N. Our knowledge expands through your efforts.

If you discover more magical works that might benefit the library, please bring them to me.
78124-complete.title: Nar'thalas Almanac

78124-progress.name: Owen Thadd
78124-progress.text: Have you brought something to add to our collection?
78124-progress.title: Nar'thalas Almanac

78127-progress.name: Owen Thadd
78127-progress.text: Have you brought something to add to our collection?
78127-progress.title: The Dalaran Digest

78143-progress.text: Have you brought something to add to our collection?
78143-progress.title: Secrets of the Dreamers

78145-progress.text: Have you brought something to add to our collection?
78145-progress.title: Arcanic Systems Manual

If you discover more magical works that might benefit the library, please bring them to me.
78146-complete.title: Goaz Scrolls

78146-progress.name: Owen Thadd
78146-progress.text: Have you brought something to add to our collection?
78146-progress.title: Goaz Scrolls

78148-complete.text:
Thank you, $N. Our knowledge expands through your efforts.

If you discover more magical works that might benefit the library, please bring them to me.
78148-complete.title: Runes of the Sorcerer-Kings

78148-progress.name: Owen Thadd
78148-progress.text: Have you brought something to add to our collection?
78148-progress.title: Runes of the Sorcerer-Kings

78149-progress.name: Owen Thadd
78149-progress.text: Have you brought something to add to our collection?
78149-progress.title: Fury of the Land

78150-complete.name: Owen Thadd
78150-complete.text:
Thanks to your donations, the library is thriving.

Please, take this.
78150-complete.title: Friend of the Library

7820-progress.name: Rumstag Proudstrider
7820-progress.text:
We are currently accepting donations for wool cloth.  A donation of sixty pieces of wool cloth will net you full recognition by Thunder Bluff for your generous actions.  Our stores are such on wool that we would only need sixty pieces from you total; we should be able to acquire enough from others in the realm to support our drive.

If you have the sixty pieces of wool cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now.
7820-progress.title: A Donation of Wool

7821-progress.name: Rumstag Proudstrider
7821-progress.text:
As with most other fabrics, our stocks of silk are at an all-time low.  Our stores are such that we'd only need sixty pieces of silk from you total; we should be able to reach our goal with the support of others.

A benevolent gift such as silk, might I add, would certainly increase your local standing in the community!  If you have the sixty pieces of silk cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now.
7821-progress.title: A Donation of Silk

79094-progress.name: Owen Thadd
79094-progress.text: Have you brought something to add to our collection?
79094-progress.title: The Lessons of Ta'zo

79095-progress.name: Owen Thadd
79095-progress.text: Have you brought something to add to our collection?
79095-progress.title: The Apothecary's Metaphysical Primer

79096-progress.text: Have you brought something to add to our collection?
79096-progress.title: Ataeric: On Arcane Curiosities

79947-progress.title: Geomancy: The Stone-Cold Truth

79950-progress.text: Have you brought something to add to our collection?
79950-progress.title: Demons and You

79951-progress.name: Owen Thadd
79951-progress.text: Have you brought something to add to our collection?
79951-progress.title: Mummies: A Guide to the Unsavory Undead

79952-progress.name: Owen Thadd
79952-progress.text: Have you brought something to add to our collection?
79952-progress.title: RwlRwlRwlRwl!

86576-progress.name: Mor'rogal
86576-progress.text: I have important matters to consider, $c. Be quick.
86576-progress.title: Bloodfury Trinkets

91901-progress.name: Dokimi
91901-progress.text: Another delivery! Fantastic. Set it over by the pile and we can discuss your compensation.
91901-progress.title: A Sealed Crate

91905-complete.name: Dokimi
91905-complete.text:
Thank you for your hard work, $N. There has been an uprising in bandits and thieves intercepting trade routes as of late. If you find other crates lying around, please bring them here and we'll handle the rest.

Here is your payment.
91905-complete.title: A Sealed Crate

91905-progress.name: Dokimi
91905-progress.text: Another delivery! Fantastic. Set it over by the pile and we can discuss your compensation.
91905-progress.title: A Sealed Crate

95805-progress.name: Unknown
95805-progress.text: <The smoke from the incense rises toward the sky.>
95805-progress.title: Grace of An'she and Mu'sha

96130-progress.name: Yaw Sharpmane
96130-progress.text: Have you found the big wolf?
96130-progress.title: Chakuyak

97485-accept.name: Eylah Sunhorn
97485-accept.text:
Blessings of An'she, friend.

We tauren have a tradition of scattering incense to the winds and I was hoping you'd be interested in honoring this tradition.

You will need to craft the incense by purchasing herbs from Nida, cedar from Nata, sinew thread from Mahu in the mid rise, and ceremonial flint and tinder from Naal on the upper rise. Once you have these items, combine them and spread them off the south facing cliff of $C's Rise.

You will find a mat and incense at the ceremonial site.
97485-accept.title: Traditions of the Bluff

97538-progress.name: Tah Winterhoof
97538-progress.text:
You have returned! Were you able to find the mirkweed plant pods in Mirkfallon Lake?

We tauren have used this plant pigment in our paints for generations, so any amount you manage to bring would be appreciated. Though there are many ways to get a red pigment, I find the mirkweed to give the richest and most vibrant hue of the methods I'm familiar with.
97538-progress.title: Pigments for Paints

98424-progress.name: Morin Cloudstalker
98424-progress.text: What is it you bring me, $c?
98424-progress.title: Fizsprocket's Notes

99108-accept.name: Krang Stonehoof
99108-accept.text:
Hail, young $c. Though you are not a warrior and I cannot teach you that path, that does not mean you would not benefit from my tutelage.

Before you lies the arena. In it, it matters not who you call mother or whether you wield sword or bow. All are equal, and all learn to sharpen their horns in direct combat.

Will you enter our space, and learn our ways for yourself? You may face any of these novices, or any other willing adversary. I care not which.
99108-accept.title: Sparring Match
